name.ja: アクセル・ワールド シルバー・クロウ

description.ja: • 「アクセル・ワールド」からシルバー・クロウがプラモ化。
description.en: • Silver Crow from "Accel World" is made into a plastic model.

description.ja: • フェイスカバーはクリアパーツで再現。
description.en: • The face cover is reproduced with clear parts.

description.ja: • 肘や膝は二重関節で、広い可動領域を実現。
description.en: • Elbows and knees are double jointed, allowing a wide range of motion.

description.ja: • 必殺技「ヘッドバッド」時のネックカバーを差し替えパーツで再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the neck cover during the special move "Head Bad" with replacement parts.

description.ja: • 背中は差替えパーツで、必殺技発動時、翼の展開時を再現可能。
description.en: • The back has replaceable parts, allowing you to recreate when the special move is activated or when the wings are deployed.

description.ja: • 多彩なハンドパーツ付属。
description.en: • Comes with a variety of hand parts.

description.ja: • 必殺技発動時の展開状態の腕を付属。各種必殺技のエフェクトパーツを取り付けられる。
description.en: • Includes arms in the expanded state when special moves are activated. You can attach effect parts for various special moves.

description.ja: 成形品×6、ホイルシール×1、組立説明書×1
description.en: Molded product x 6, foil seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
